questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn that a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians on or near the road. Follow any instructions from crossing guards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: The road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings ahead. Look for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When turning left at a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. Turn only when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: A traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: Slow down and let other traffic go first. You must yield the right-of-way to traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This lane is reserved only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it for passing or going straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane does not continue through the interchange. If you stay in this lane, you must exit. You can change lanes to continue on the freeway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Drivers in the left lane must turn left. This rule must be followed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers of work zones ahead. This sign tells you a construction or maintenance area is coming. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road will curve to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always give way to pedestrians in crosswalks. Watch carefully when driving through intersections or turning, as children may be crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to hazards ahead. These object markers warn you about dangerous objects or areas to avoid.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare you for road hazards. This sign alerts you that traffic is merging from the right. Prepare to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Follow a detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main highway if you can.
Follow a detour to the right, but only if it's convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow a detour to the right.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs direct you around blocked roads. Follow the detour route shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downhill grade ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns drivers about upcoming hazards. It tells you to watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead is divided by a center median. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a sharp right turn is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers the parking rules they must follow. You can park here for a maximum of two hours during the times shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign is posted at traffic signals. It means you cannot turn right when the light is red at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road surface is slippery when wet. Drive carefully in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people entering or crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Should maintain your vehicle’s speed until you enter the reduced speed zone.
Should begin to reduce your vehicle’s speed.
Should not slow down because traffic will start to back up.
May reduce your speed, if you choose to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should begin to reduce your vehicle’s speed.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to start slowing down now. The new speed limit will begin at the next speed limit sign.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.
